_comment: Class of the trained detector (Roboflow cable-defect v3: foreign, hole, scratch, spot) -> defect code of the application. Only the defects these four visual classes stand for can be proposed; the other codes (dimensions, resistance, spark test...) cannot be seen on a photo of this kind and stay manual. A detector whose classes are named like the codes needs no entry here (see cv_mapping.py). The stock yolov8n.pt knows none of these classes: with it the service answers available=false.
